metadata.title: Sttok security: ISO 27001, GDPR and security policy
metadata.description: Sttok holds ISO 27001 certification and complies with the GDPR. Data in AWS Europe encrypted with TLS 1.3 and AES-256, sign-in with Google or Microsoft SSO or a one-time code, and permissions per company.

hero.title: Sttok security: ISO 27001, GDPR and security policy
hero.description: Sttok holds ISO 27001 certification, complies with the GDPR and hosts data in AWS Europe, encrypted with TLS 1.3 and AES-256. Users sign in with Google or Microsoft SSO or a one-time code, and each user only sees the companies assigned to them.

content.title: Certifications and compliance
content: Sttok holds ISO 27001 certification in information security and complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Bureau Veritas audits that certification.
The information it protects includes shareholder registers, minutes, resolutions and the documentation of the meetings of the companies it manages.

content.title: Infrastructure and data protection
content: Data is hosted in AWS Europe, with no international data transfers.
Information is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256.
The data processing agreement (DPA) is available on request.
The service level agreement (SLA) is available on custom plans.

content.title: Access and permissions
content: Users sign in with Google or Microsoft single sign-on (SSO), using their company account. Users without SSO sign in with a one-time code (OTP).
Permissions are assigned per company. In a group or a law firm, each user only sees the companies assigned to them.
Shareholders, investors and incentive plan beneficiaries sign in to their own portal and only see their position, their certificates and their documents.
Communications to shareholders and directors keep their delivery history and proof of delivery.

content.title: What the policy covers
content: The policy sets as its objective ensuring the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information.
It includes business continuity plans, risk identification and assessment, indicators to measure the security of processes and a continuous improvement system.
Management commits to complying with current legislation, regulatory requirements and contractual obligations regarding information security.

content.title: Sttok's Information Security Policy Statement
content: The essential principles and guidelines on which Sttok's Information Security Policy is based are as follows:
• Develop our activities and processes towards understanding the needs of customers to ensure their full satisfaction, always following principles of transparency and integrity.
• Involve all Sttok members in the Information Security strategy, through participation in its development and implementation.
• Communication, cooperation and training of personnel are basic lines of action.

• Management promotes the professional development of employees, aware of their influence on commitment and motivation and, by extension, on the achievement of objectives and the Organization's Mission.
• Medium and long-term planning, with the establishment of priorities and objectives, to facilitate the progress of the Organization.
• Implementation of a continuous improvement system of activities, processes and services, identifying the most significant aspects that allow the search for improvement opportunities.
• Excellence in service, innovation and profit through efficiency, are aspects that should characterize our actions and collaborations, as well as the processes designed for this purpose.

• Ensure the Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability of information, as well as have the capacity to respond to emergency situations, establishing Business Continuity Plans proportional to the Organization's context, is a permanent attitude of Sttok.
• Establish specific Information Security objectives and have measures aimed at identifying and evaluating risks that may affect their achievement.

• The analysis and measurement of Information Security of all operational and support processes, through appropriate indicators, is essential to know their evolution and apply improvements in the objectives set.
• Management's commitment to compliance with the requirements of current legislation, other regulatory requirements and contractual obligations regarding information security.

content: October, 2026

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about Sttok security

items.a: Yes. Sttok holds ISO 27001 certification in information security, audited by Bureau Veritas.
In AWS Europe, with no international data transfers. It is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256.

items.q: Can users sign in with their company account?
items.a: Yes, with Google or Microsoft single sign-on. Users without SSO sign in with a one-time code.

items.q: Does every user see all the companies in the group?
items.a: No. Permissions are assigned per company and each user only sees the companies assigned to them.

items.q: Do you sign a data processing agreement?
items.a: Yes. The data processing agreement (DPA) is available on request.

items.q: Is there a service level agreement?
items.a: Yes, on custom plans, which are the plans for groups and companies with more than 50 shareholders.
